newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 surges at end of bullish week.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 surges at end of bullish week.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index soared again on Friday led by very strong gains to the bourse's three most heavily weighted shares, which together account for around 45 percent of the PX50's capitalisation.
SPT Telecom rose 90 crowns, 2.3 percent, to 4,050, CEZ rose 37 crowns, three percent, to 1,264 and Komercni Banka, the week's star performer rose 4.9 percent, to 3,050.
"It's the psychology of the mass (group). Our analysts predict further increases in the next months," said Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities in Prague.
The Czech PX50 has risen four percent this week alone.
In the broader market, petrochemical issues Kaucuk and Chemopetrol surged. Kaucuk gained 68 crowns to 1,432, while Chemopetrol rose 41 crowns to 1,365.
Brewery stocks alos had a good session. Radegast, 33 percent owned by Bass, rose 105 crowns to 4,605 while Prazske Pivovary 55 percent owned by Bass, gained 21 crowns to 2,571.
Overall, turnover remained relatively high at 1.4 billion crowns while volume was 1,055,627 shares. on the bourse as a whole, 234 shares rose, 252 fell and 178 were unchanged.
